title: Can a Real World Asset Be CROPS Aligned?
description:
Most RWAs are "Real World Receipts": you hold a token, but the claim behind it can still be frozen, seized, or switched off by an issuer, SPV, or transfer agent. That makes them fragile exactly where Ethereum is strong.

I apply the walkaway test to these assets: if the team, frontend, and SPV vanish tonight, can you still get your asset out? I also use CROPS values (censorship resistance, open source, privacy, security) as a scoring rubric against real designs, exposing their central points of failure.

Then the constructive half: I design a theoretical RWA that passes these tests, and map which legal and technical pieces exist today and which don't yet. You leave with a rubric to audit any RWA's sovereignty claims yourself.
